package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

echo

  - systemctl enable --now chrony

package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

package_update: true
packages:
  - chrony
  - openssh-server
  - curl
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - timedatectl set-timezone America/El_Salvador || true
  - sed -i '/^pool /d;/^server /d' /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - printf 'server ntp.ues.edu.sv iburst\n' >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
  - systemctl enable --now chrony
  - systemctl enable --now ssh
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
  - chmod 700 /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/admin/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /home/admin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
  - chown -R admin:admin /home/admin/.ssh
  - chmod 700 /root/.ssh
  - chmod 600 /root/.ssh/id_rsa /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  - chmod 644 /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub

echo

append_file_to_log 'guest-network-config /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml' /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml
local 'title=guest-network-config /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml'
local file_path=/tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml
[[ -n /home/uceda/Documents/cluster-ceph/kvm-generic/logs/04-28-22-00.txt ]]
[[ -f /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml ]]
echo '# guest-network-config /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml'
# guest-network-config /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml
cat /tmp/network-config-ceph-osd3.yaml
version: 2
ethernets:
  enp1s0:
    match:
      macaddress: 52:54:00:cc:dd:14
    set-name: enp1s0
    dhcp4: false
    addresses: [192.168.3.14/24]
    routes:
      - to: default
        via: 192.168.3.1
    nameservers:
      addresses: [8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4]
echo

[[ -n '' ]]
sudo virsh dominfo ceph-osd3
echo '[WARN] La VM ceph-osd3 ya existe en libvirt. Se omite creacion.'
echo '[OK] VM procesada: ceph-osd3'
echo '[INFO] MAC primaria configurada: 52:54:00:cc:dd:14'
sudo virsh domifaddr ceph-osd3 --source agent
awk '/ipv4/ {split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]; exit}'
vm_ip=127.0.0.1
[[ -z 127.0.0.1 ]]
[[ -n 127.0.0.1 ]]
echo '[INFO] IP detectada para ceph-osd3: 127.0.0.1'
echo '[INFO] Conexion sugerida: ssh admin@127.0.0.1'
stop_command_trace
local exit_code=0
[[ true != \t\r\u\e ]]
set +x
# host-trace-fin 2026-04-28 22:02:29
